items.q: Can I wear them all day?
items.a: Yes. Eyegis frames are designed for continuous wear — lightweight TR90 build, balanced weight distribution and coatings tuned for long sessions.
Yes. EyegisGuard™ lenses preserve natural color perception and are safe for daytime driving.

items.q: Do they change colors on my screen?
items.a: No. The filter is tuned to attenuate high-energy blue light without introducing a visible amber tint — color-critical work stays accurate.

items.q: Can I wear them with contact lenses?
items.a: Yes. Eyegis frames pair comfortably with soft or rigid contact lenses.

items.q: Are they compatible with gaming headsets?
items.a: Yes. The temple arms are slim enough to sit comfortably under most on-ear and over-ear gaming headsets.

items.q: Can I use them while reading?
items.a: Yes — the coating supports both screen and print. Many readers find them noticeably more comfortable at night.
